'''Sajin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had [[Color/Legends|black]] hair, green eyes, and tan skin, and was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] before or during [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />

During a mission on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in 3642 BBY, Sajin was part of [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun's]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] until they were ambushed by Sith Imperials. A [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic trooper]] was able to drive them out of the attack, but Sajin was badly wounded from the confrontation. The [[Havoc Squad]] medical specialist, [[Elara Dorne]], did all she could to ease Sajin's pain, but the injuries were fatal. Sajin asked the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] to warn about the cause and died from his wounds. The captain fulfilled that promise.<ref name="TOR" />
